entities.name: Riptide Project
entities.description: A conglomeration of blue wizards on Riptide Island founded around 4305 AR to further understanding of surface and Mer magic.

entities.name: Riptide Island
entities.description: Island off mainland Otaria hosting the project.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Creatures the project recreated that escaped and spread over Dominaria.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: Controller of slivers, absent from the experiments.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Rumored to have an interest in the project.

entities.name: Pemmin
entities.description: The only researcher known to survive the sliver onslaught.

events.summary: Empress Llawan founded the Riptide Project to repair relations between surface and the Mer Empire.
events.quote: The Riptide Project was founded by Empress Llawan

events.summary: The project recreated slivers, which without the Sliver Queen ran wild, slaughtered most researchers and spread over Dominaria.
events.quote: the slivers ran wild and slaughtered most of the researchers

events.summary: Pemmin was the only known researcher to survive.
events.quote: there was only one researcher known to have survived the Slivers' devastating onslaught
